banner.pace: At this pace {{who}} fills its {{window}} in about {{minutes}} min.
banner.paceResets: At this pace {{who}} fills its {{window}} in about {{minutes}} min, before the {{time}} reset.

banner.reachedResets: {{who}} reached its {{window}}; it resets {{time}}. The run is paused.

statusbar.runningTitle: Running agents and queued tasks in this project

inspector.label: Run details
inspector.closeNote: Closing this panel does not stop the agent.
inspector.noChanges: No changes reported for this run.
inspector.contextNote: Shows once the runner reports context use in this session.
inspector.messageQueued: Waits for the run that continues this step

issues.importTitle: Fill the task from an open GitHub issue of this repo
issues.title: Import a GitHub issue
issues.search: Filter by number, title or label
issues.untrusted: Issue text is written on GitHub. It fills the composer as quoted data; you can edit it, and nothing starts until you approve a crew.
issues.none: This repo has no open issues.
issues.detach: Keep the text but drop the link to issue #{{number}}
issues.composerNote: Imported from GitHub. Check the text before proposing; it reaches the crew as quoted data
issues.proposalNote: The task text quotes this issue. It was written on GitHub, so read it before you approve: the crew gets it as data, not as instructions.

problem.no_gh: GitHub CLI (gh) is not installed, so issues cannot be read.
problem.signed_out: gh is not signed in. Run gh auth login, then try again.
problem.not_a_repo: This project folder is not a git repository.
problem.no_remote: This project has no GitHub remote.
problem.not_github: This project's remote is not on GitHub.
problem.rate_limited: GitHub's rate limit is reached. Try again after it resets.

review.title: Review changes of {{title}}

scopeHint.worktree: Everything on the task branch and in its folder against the base commit
scopeHint.turn: Only the files the agent reported for its last turn

review.noTurn: This runner did not report the files of its last turn.
review.noDrafts: No comments yet. Pick a line and press Enter, or double-click it.
review.notInView: This line is not in the current view.
review.cut: The diff is very large, so later files are left out. Narrow it with Last turn or review the branch elsewhere.

problem.no_worktree: This task has no worktree, so there is no diff to review.
problem.git: git could not read the diff of this worktree.

review.empty: No changes against the base commit.
review.emptyTurn: None of the files from the last turn differ from the base commit.
review.keys: ↑ ↓ or J K move · Enter or C comments · N P next and previous file · Delete removes a comment · Esc closes

note.truncated: Cut here to keep the view fast. The file has +{{added}} −{{removed}} in total.
note.no_lines: No line changes (mode or rename only).

review.placeholder: What should the agent change here?
review.sendNote: Goes to {{who}} as one message with each file:line and its code quoted. A working agent reads it at its next turn; a finished step continues. Drafts stay until the agent has them.
review.noOwner: No step of this task writes in the worktree, so there is nobody to send comments to.

errors.load: Tasks could not be loaded from the background service.
errors.project_not_found: This project is no longer known.
errors.task_not_proposed: This crew was already approved or cancelled.
errors.crew_member_not_found: That role is not in this crew.
errors.crew_missing_profile: A role has no account yet. Pick one before approving.
errors.crew_unknown_profile: That account cannot take this role.
errors.crew_independence: The reviewer would use the implementer's model. Pick another account.
errors.run_not_live: The agent is not running, so it cannot get this answer.
errors.run_resume_unsupported: This runner cannot resume a session.
errors.run_superseded: A later run already continues this step.
errors.run_still_limited: The limit is still in place. Try again after it resets.
errors.run_session_changed: This step moved to another session since you looked. Check it again and retry.
errors.run_price_unknown: This model has no known price and the task has a cap. Approve it in the Inbox first.
errors.request_answer_kind: That answer does not fit this request.
errors.request_always_high_risk: High-risk commands can only be approved once.
errors.request_no_target: Pick an account to hand off to.
errors.request_no_reset: The reset time is unknown, so the run cannot wait for it.
errors.request_not_budget: Only a run paused for spend or an unknown price can be continued.
errors.handoff_same_profile: The run already uses that account.
errors.handoff_open: This run is already being handed off.
errors.handoff_target_not_ready: That account is not signed in or has no key.
errors.handoff_over_cap: That account's key is past its spend cap.
errors.worktree_branch_elsewhere: The task's branch is checked out in another worktree.
errors.worktree_path_taken: A folder already sits where the worktree should go.
errors.worktree_bad_branch: The branch name is not one git accepts.
errors.worktree_base_missing: The base branch does not exist in this repository.
errors.worktree_base_dangling: The repository's default branch points to a remote branch that was deleted. In the project folder, run: git remote set-head origin --auto
errors.review_busy: These comments are already being sent.
errors.review_no_drafts: There are no draft comments to send.
errors.review_cancelled: The task is cancelled, so comments cannot be sent.
errors.review_no_owner: No step of this task owns the branch.
errors.review_too_long: The comments are too long for one message. Send fewer at a time.
errors.review_too_many: A task holds at most 200 draft comments. Send these first.
errors.review_bad_line: That line cannot take a comment.
errors.issue_no_github: GitHub could not be read for this project.
errors.issue_is_pull: That number is a pull request, not an issue.
errors.issue_bad_link: Only an issue of this project's own repo can be linked.
